description: This Rust source file defines functions and data structures for formatting JSON API responses into various human-readable formats such as JSON, YAML, CSV, and tables. It includes support for paginated output, nested object flattening, and special handling for multi-byte characters. The file also contains unit tests for its formatting functions.

classes.name: OutputFormat
classes.description: An enum representing supported output formats: JSON, Table, YAML, CSV.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string into an OutputFormat, returning an error string if unrecognized.

methods.name: from_str
methods.description: Parses a string into an OutputFormat, defaulting to JSON on unknown values.

methods.name: format_value
methods.description: Formats a JSON value into a string according to the specified output format.

methods.name: format_value_paginated
methods.description: Formats a JSON value for paginated output, handling first page vs continuation.
